name: operator
definition: Subject is operated by the named legal entity.
data-schema: operator-data = { ? name: tstr, * tstr => any }   ; recommended layout, not enforced
title: Operator
description: Names the legal entity (never a private individual, spec section 16 point 1) that operates the subject. Any issuer may make the statement; whether a verifier accepts it depends on its trust policy and the issuer's chain to a root.
The data map is free. The recommended layout is {"name": tstr}.
issued-by: Any issuer (in ATEP-R, the fleet operator)
subject: Agent ID operated by the entity
attestation-schema:
attestation = {
  subject: agent-id,
  issuer: agent-id,                      ; MUST equal the envelope signer
  claim: uri,
  data: { * tstr => any },
  ? evidence: bstr .size 32,
  ? evidence-uri: uri,
  id: bstr .size 16,
}
agent-id = bstr .size 32
uri = tstr
lifetime: 30 to 180 days by default, 400 days at most
